programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Arthur bought his Cyclone new in 1967. Then, his father put 400,000 miles on it. Now, he wants FantomWorks to make it better than new. Antonio and his cousin Andres challenge Dan to build the fastest Mustang CS in Mexico.

programme.title: Big Time Presents: Mustang Build
programme.sub-title: Why Ford Built 20,000,000 of this Engine
programme.desc: The untold story of Ford's most mass-produced engine. Why 20 million were built and what made it unstoppable.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Taming a 1971 Challenger R/T

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: FantomWorks finish the build of the ultimate Mustang Sleeper, a California Special powered by a Coyote Aluminator. Phil wants a 1949 Chevy Pick-up, but the truck is a disassembled jigsaw puzzle with a lot of pieces missing.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: John thinks his 1958 Corvette is ‘mostly original’ but Dan finds a mismatched assortment of poor-quality parts and bad repairs. Chelsea wants FantomWorks to fix up a rare 1971 Fury for her father, Rikk. The car has previously caught on fire 3 times!

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: A 1917 Overland will be FantomWorks oldest restoration, if they can solve this jigsaw puzzle of rotted wood and rusted steel. Dan buys a 1968 Camaro on the internet for his wife, Malissa, and finds out that the car is in extremely poor condition.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: When George brings his beloved 1971 Mustang Mach 1 in for a few repairs, Dan realizes that his car has been jumped. Mick hired a shop to restore his 1952 Mercury Woody. The shop went bust, so FantomWorks is challenged to pick up the pieces. Literally.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: David and Chuck want their family heirloom 1961 International Harvester Metro Van converted into a state-of-the-art restomod, with all the trimmings. David asks Dan to find and restore a very specific car he’s always wanted: a 1966 Lincoln Convertible.

programme.desc: Es ist die mysteriöseste Handschrift der Welt: Von einem unbekannten Autor verfasst, illustriert mit ebenso skurrilen wie rätselhaften Darstellungen - und in einer Sprache geschrieben, die von den besten Kryptographen nicht entschlüsselt werden kann.

programme.title: Asia: vite segrete, luoghi nascosti
programme.desc: Gli angoli più remoti della giungla nel Vietnam del Nord rappresentano un rifugio per animali in pericolo. Conosceremo un piccolo gruppo etnico, i Dan Lai, che vive soltanto qui.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.sub-title: Salmoni e castori nel Nord dell'Alaska
programme.desc: Il folle salmone torna al fiume natio per riprodursi, mentre l'orso lo aspetta. Castori costruiscono dighe e lontre giocano innamorate.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: In India, ogni creatura è sacra e consapevole. Avvoltoi, cervi, tigri, cobra ed elefanti vivono in armonia, consapevoli della propria divinità e del ciclo eterno della vita. Un'ode alla sacralità della natura indiana.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: L'america delle Montagne Rocciose, tra alci, mufloni, procioni, coyote e bisonti millenari. Un racconto di amore e sopravvivenza nella natura incontaminata.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Nella savana africana, la velocità è vitale. Struzzi, gazzelle, zebre e gnu corrono per sopravvivere. Un circo spietato, mitigato dall'eleganza delle giraffe.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Il mare, rifugio del mondo animale, culla di forme singolari: mante, meduse, stelle marine, scorfani, piovre, squali e balene pacifiche.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Il Rio delle Amazzoni, un bacino immenso dove l'acqua genera la vita, dominato da predatori feroci e allietato da uccelli colorati e creature buffe

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Nella savana africana, la lotta per la sopravvivenza del licaone, un canide tanto feroce quanto inquietante, mantiene l'equilibrio della vita.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Nel freddo del nord, gli animali lottano per sopravvivere, ma l'alce, la lontra e il lemming strappano un sorriso, mentre il ghiottone ristabilisce l'equilibrio.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: La vita nasce dall'infinitamente piccolo. Insetti di ogni forma e colore lottano per mangiare, crescere e riprodursi in un miracolo fugace.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Sotto i mari, la vita primordiale regna. Cernie, pellicani e leoni marini lottano per la sopravvivenza. La lontra di mare, seducente e felice, mitiga la durezza di questo mondo. Un contrasto tra lotta e gioia nell'universo marino.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Il lupo incompreso, abile cacciatore, viene mostrato nella sua vera luce. Intelligente, organizzato e devoto al suo branco.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Uno spettacolo arcaico dove i coccodrilli imparano a riconoscere la madre, gli ippopotami si fanno rispettare, i leoni cacciano e gli elefanti sono intelligenti.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: La difficile convivenza tra animali e uomo, mitigata da gesti d'amore e cura per ripopolare le specie cacciate e riconquistare la fiducia del regno animale.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Un viaggio nella fauna australiana, tra draghi veloci, canguri pugili, koala pacifici e uccelli canori, in un continente dove la natura regna sovrana.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Frederic Rossif si immerge sotto la superficie per mostrare la maestosa vita del mare profondo.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Rossif cattura la bellezza dei ghepardi in un mondo dove la natura è in costante battaglia per la sopravvivenza.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Rossif cattura con poesia la natura incantevole degli Incas. Un Eden terribile e sublime, dove la vita e la morte si intrecciano in un ciclo eterno di riproduzione e rinascita.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Il Parco Nazionale dello Yellowstone attraverso gli occhi del Regista Frédéric Rossif

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Un viaggio nell'esotica fauna asiatica, tra draghi di Komodo e colombe coronate, che svela ferocia, spiritualità e interazioni uniche tra specie diverse, offrendo uno sguardo sulla bellezza fragile della vita selvatica.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Rossif esplora il complesso mondo delle scimmie, dal riflessivo orango al bellicoso scimpanzé, rivelando la loro intelligenza, gerarchie sociali e il rapporto conflittuale con l'uomo, che ha ristretto il loro habitat, suscitando ribellione.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Animali che ignorano confini politici migrano liberamente. Il documentario mostra la loro resilienza in vari ambienti, sottolineando la necessità di proteggere queste specie libere.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Il documentario esplora il rapporto tra uomo e cavallo, dalle origini selvagge dei mustang alle esibizioni in Perù e ai cavalli di Przewalski.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Un tasso e una lince: predatori diversi, strategie opposte! Il documentario svela le incredibili interazioni del tasso e l'implacabile caccia della lince.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Un viaggio nel cuore dell'Amazzonia svela la spietata legge della giungla, dove ogni creatura lotta per la sopravvivenza, tra scimmie urlatrici, lontre giganti e gimnoti elettrici.

programme.title: Bellezza selvaggia
programme.desc: Il documentario esplora la vita di pellicani, aquile urlatrici, avvoltoi, gru coronate e fenicotteri, svelando le loro strategie di sopravvivenza e tradizioni in Africa.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Novembernebel
programme.desc: Der November bringt nach den letzten schönen Wetterperioden im Oktober vor allem Sturm, Kälte und Nebel mit sich. Der Winter naht und Mensch und Natur haben allerhand zu tun.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Winterboten
programme.desc: Ende November kündigt sich der bevorstehende Winter mit langen, frostigen Nächten und immer kürzer werdenden Tagen an. In höheren Lagen liegt bereits der erste Schnee.

programme.title: Im Bann der Jahreszeiten: Erster Schnee

programme.desc: Beginn des Mercury-Projekts: der Start des ersten bemannten Raumfahrtprogramms der NASA und der Vereinigten Staaten.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Star Trek: Lower Decks
programme.desc: Staffelfinale. Die USS Cerritos trifft auf einen bekannten Gegner. Tendi hilft einer strauchelnden Rekrutin, sich zurechtzufinden.

programme.title: Star Trek: Lower Decks
programme.desc: Staffel-Premiere. Ungefähr drei Monate nach den Ereignissen von Staffel Eins wird die USS Cerritos auf eine Mission entsandt, die zu einer Begegnung mit "seltsamen Energien" führt.

programme.title: Star Trek: Lower Decks
programme.desc: Unsere Unterdeckler werden nicht warm mit Ensign Jet Manhaver, der Boimlers Kojen- und Schichtnachfolger wird. Währenddessen erhaschen wir einen Einblick in Boimlers Leben auf der USS Titan, das aufregender ausfällt als erwartet.

programme.title: Star Trek: Lower Decks
programme.desc: Tendi erhält einen Spezialauftrag von Dr. T'Ana und bittet Mariner um Hilfe. Auf der USS Cerritos versucht Rutherford, einem Geheimnis der Brückencrew auf die Spur zu kommen.

programme.title: Die Enterprise: Die Rettungsmission
programme.desc: Die Besatzung der Enterprise schrumpft, nachdem sie in Strahlung ausgesetzt wurde.

programme.title: Die Enterprise: Die Zeitfalle
programme.desc: Die Enterprise und ein klingonisches Schiff müssen sich zusammentun, um aus einem Taschenuniversum zu entkommen, in dem Raumschiffe seit Jahrhunderten gefangen sind.

programme.title: Die Enterprise: Die Entführung
programme.desc: Bei der Erkundung des Planeten Argo werden Kirk und Spock in Wasseratmer verwandelt.

programme.title: Die Enterprise: Der Überlebende
programme.desc: Die Enterprise findet den vermissten Händler und Philanthropen Carter Winston, aber er ist vielleicht nicht das, was er zu sein scheint.

programme.title: Die Enterprise: Auf der Suche nach Überlebenden
programme.desc: Auf der Suche nach einem verschollenen Schiff werden Kirk, Spock und McCoy von hochentwickelten, telepathischen Außerirdischen gefangen genommen und in einem Zoo untergebracht.

programme.title: Die Enterprise: Das Superhirn
programme.desc: Kirk und die Crew begegnen einer Rasse intelligenter Pflanzen und einem verrückten Wissenschaftler, der der Galaxis Frieden bringen will.

programme.title: Die Enterprise: Die Piraten von Orion
programme.desc: Spock erkrankt an einer für Vulkanier tödlichen Krankheit. Die Enterprise trifft auf einen Frachter mit einer Ladung Medikamente, die das einzige Heilmittel sind, aber Orion-Piraten greifen das Schiff an. Kirk muss sie aufspüren, bevor es zu spät ist.

programme.title: Die Enterprise: Gefährliche Prüfung
programme.desc: Auf einer Planetenerkundungsmission müssen sich Kirk und Spock mit einem rücksichtslosen Beobachter namens Bem auseinandersetzen.

programme.title: Die Enterprise: Das Geheimnis der Stasis-Box
programme.desc: Spock, Sulu und Uhura werden von den Kzinti gefangen genommen, die versuchen, das Geheimnis einer uralten Waffe zu erfahren.

programme.title: La Confraternita: I Misteri Del Templo Solare
programme.desc: L’episodio indaga la strage dell’Ordine del Tempio Solare: 53 morti tra Svizzera e Canada. Lettere e registrazioni rivelano omicidi mascherati da suicidi, voluti da Di Mambro per nascondere truffe e far sparire anche chi gli era più vicino.

programme.title: La Confraternita: I Misteri Del Templo Solare
programme.desc: Coinvolto anche Jean Vuarnet nello scandalo del Temple Solaire: il figlio Patrick e la moglie Édith erano membri della setta e morirono nel presunto suicidio di massa sul massiccio del Vercors, in Svizzera, insieme ad altri adepti.

programme.title: La Confraternita: I Misteri Del Templo Solare
programme.desc: L’episodio segue i processi contro Michel Tabachnik, accusato d’istigazione al suicidio per i suoi scritti esoterici. Assolto definitivamente, il caso sembra chiuso, ma due anni dopo un nuovo suicidio di massa dell’Ordine colpisce ancora in Canada.

programme.title: Attentato al papa
programme.desc: Roma. 13 Maggio, 1981, ore 17:00. Giovanni Paolo II attraversa Piazza San Pietro su di una Jeep aperta tra migliaia di persone che lo acclamano. Improvvisamente tre colpi risuonano attraverso la Piazza. Il Papa collassa.

programme.title: Mohenjo Daro, le guerre degli Dei
programme.desc: Tra le rovine di Mohenjo Daro, in Pakistan, riaffiorano tracce di un’antica catastrofe di 5.000 anni fa. Cosa accadde davvero? Un’indagine affascinante svela l’ipotesi di un conflitto aereo tra antichi Dei.

programme.title: Anna e Maria Bolena - Storie di due sorelle
programme.desc: Nonostante sia una celebre figura storica, si sa molto poco di Anna Bolena e ancora meno di sua sorella Mary. In questo documentario scopriremo la loro affascinante storia.

programme.title: Elisabetta I e Maria la Sanguinaria - Storie di due sorelle
programme.desc: Maria la Sanguinaria fu regina cattolica e regnò per soli cinque anni, mentre Elisabetta I, protestante, regnò a lungo in un periodo di straordinaria fioritura artistica e culturale. Le due figlie di Enrico VIII avevano più in comune di quanto appaia.

programme.title: La Regina Elisabetta e Margaret - Storie di due sorelle
programme.desc: La Regina Elisabetta e sua sorella Margaret furono la prima generazione di reali a nascere sotto lo sguardo attento dei media.

programme.title: Anna Frank e Eva Schloss - Storie di due sorelle
programme.desc: La storia di Anna Frank e della sua futura sorellastra Eva Schloss, sopravvissuta ad Auschwitz. Il Diario di Anna Frank fu ritrovato dal padre Otto nel 1947, ed Eva fu una delle prime persone a leggerlo e seguirne la pubblicazione.

programme.title: Scopriamo La Storia
programme.desc: Hitler puntava a sorprendere il nemico con attacchi rapidi per impedirne la difesa. Tuttavia, si rivelò un dilettante: i suoi errori strategici portarono alla rovina della Germania, smentendo la sua fama di brillante stratega militare.

programme.title: Scopriamo La Storia
programme.sub-title: Hiroshima Ha Causato La Resa Del Giappone?
programme.desc: Dopo la bomba di Hiroshima, l’Armata Rossa invade il Giappone per impedirne la resa agli USA. Sotto pressione russa e americana, il Giappone si arrende agli USA per condizioni migliori.

programme.title: Scopriamo La Storia
programme.desc: Il Piano Marshall del ’47 aiutò l’Europa ma mirava anche a contenere il comunismo e creare mercati per l’export USA, rafforzando economia americana e blocco occidentale.

programme.title: Scopriamo La Storia
programme.desc: Mao salì al potere nel ’49, dipese da Mosca, poi si staccò, militarizzò le masse e eliminò oppositori. Il suo governo causò carestia e stagnazione. Morì nel ’76 con la Cina ancora lontana dal sogno.

programme.title: Guerra Di Corea
programme.desc: Crisi nella penisola coreana: Kim Jong-un sfida USA, Cina e Corea del Sud con missili nucleari. Trump minaccia ogni opzione, anche militare. La storia parte da 35 anni di occupazione giapponese, la divisione del ’45 e la guerra tra Nord e Sud.

programme.title: Le Petit Prince
programme.desc: Sur cette planète, les Chlorophylliens ont de sérieux problèmes avec leurs plantations, qui dépérissent. Le Petit Prince comprend que le problème vient des étoiles, qui ont une influence directe sur la végétation.

programme.title: Le Petit Prince
programme.desc: Il découvre alors que l’astronome arrache étoiles et planètes, afin de recréer dans son antre une parfaite voûte céleste…

programme.title: Le Petit Prince
programme.desc: Le Petit Prince découvre que les Globies ne sont pas les méchants.

programme.title: Le Petit Prince
programme.desc: Le Petit Prince découvre que les Globies ne sont pas les méchants.

programme.title: Le Petit Prince
programme.desc: Depuis des générations, sur cette planète cubique, les hommes obéissent sans broncher aux ordres de Griffin : rester sur la face supérieure du cube (la face horizontale). Car s’ils s’arrêtent, ils tomberont dans le vide galactique.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Tout affairé au grand nettoyage de printemps, Candy remarque tout à coup un étrange personnage qui farfouille dans les poubelles de la maison à louer.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Dans son laboratoire, Etno s’extasie devant la résistance et l’intelligence extraordinaire d’un cafard. Il en conclut que le cafard est la créature la plus parfaite de la terre.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Bud, en pleine crise d’adolescence, adopte les comportements typiques de cet âge difficile : musique, langage et mauvaises manières.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Et voilà ! Encore des nouveaux locataires ! Nos amis n’en peuvent plus. Ces humains sont trop bêtes. Etno est persuadé qu’autrefois, moins nombreux sur terre, les humains devaient être moins gênants.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Depuis des jours et des nuits, Candy ne cesse de passer et repasser les disques de Snoutra, son chanteur de charme préféré. Les monstres sont à bout.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Dévorant du matin au soir une quantité impressionnante de gâteaux et bonbons en tous genres, Gorgious est atteint d’une véritable boulimie de sucreries.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Soignant avec amour ses amies les plantes, Candy prépare activement le Concours Annuel des Plantes et Jardins.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.sub-title: Règlement de compte à Tiny Town
programme.desc: Privé de sa télévision tombée en panne au milieu de son western favori, Bud erre comme une âme en peine dans le grenier.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Les résultats de la loterie donnent le billet de Gorgious gagnant : 10 Millions de dollars!

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Epuisé par ses recherches et désespéré par le désordre endémique de son laboratoire, Etno se bricole un robot domestique pour exécuter toute la besogne à sa place.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Frappé par un météore surgie de nulle part, un bus intergalactique s’écrase sur la Terre. Cinq monstres étranges, Etno, Gorgious, Bud, Candy et Stereo, émergent du véhicule.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Un voisin fouineur épie à la jumelle toutes les maisons du quartier. La moindre ombre suspecte lui apparaît comme un cambrioleur ou un criminel en puissance.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Par une chaude soirée d’été, les monstres, rassemblés autour d’un feu de camp, évoquent les bonnes vieilles histoires de leur planète natale.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Un raton laveur cartoon facétieux attire Bud dans la télé et en profite pour s’échapper dans le réel !

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Des choses bizarres commencent à se passer dans la maison à louer. Quelqu’un farfouille dans les affaires des monstres !

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Une fuite d'eau, provoquée par Gorgious endormi dans son bain, donne à Etno une idée de génie : pour ne plus avoir affaire aux humains dont l'élément naturel est l'air, il faut inonder la maison…

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Fox Bongo, richissime créateur mégalomane et « congelé » du célèbre personnage animé "Wheezy la fouine", débarque à l'improviste : il veut acheter le terrain et la maison pour réaliser un grand parc d’attractions.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Un nouveau locataire à l'allure de fonctionnaire sage, emménage dans la maison... En réalité, il s'agit du « super héros », Flashman qui tourbillonne et virevolte comme une tornade dans la maison.

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Grand nettoyage de printemps dans la maison, sous la houlette de Candy ! Gorgious dévolu à l'astiquage des toilettes, délivre par mégarde le "génie à la cuvette".

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: Une foule d’hommes en short et torse nu entre dans la maison et ressort dans un état pitoyable…

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Un aigle maladroit laisse tomber sa proie, un lapin, sur le pont du cargo. Un lapin sur un bateau, ça porte malheur !

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Benny fait monter à bord un sharpeï et deux pinschers qu'il installe dans un chenil cosy sur le pont. Voyant le cuistot nourrir les chiens, les rats présument aussitôt qu'il les engraisse avant de les manger.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Rapido raille Razmo qui tente de le convaincre de l’intelligence de ces animaux que l’on appelle "humains". C’est alors qu’embarque Jordy, le neveu du Capitaine, venu passer ses vacances en pleine mer.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Suite à une malencontreuse manœuvre du Capitaine, le cargo se retrouve bloqué dans les glaces du pôle Nord. Surpris par le gel, Rapido glisse sur le pont et tombe à la mer.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Une équipe de cheese-ball composée de castors monte à bord le temps d’un trajet. Rapido est aux anges, c’est son sport préféré !

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: L’équipage charge une caisse mystérieuse à destination d’Ibiza. Malgré les recommandations du client, Benny ouvre la caisse pour en voir le contenu. Là, six tatous énormes se libèrent et fuient dans les calles.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Razmo est à bout : il vient encore une fois de laisser le dernier mot à Rapido. Il ne comprend pas pourquoi il ne trouve pas la force de lui répondre, alors qu’il sait pertinemment qu’il est plus intelligent que ce frimeur…

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Un soir, alors que les rats observent les étoiles, bien calés dans leurs transats, l’une d’elle grossit subitement et vient s’écraser sur… Razmo !

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Bien décidé à prendre un nouveau départ dans sa vie, Razmo se débarrasse de ses vieilles inventions inutiles.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Il pleut sans interruption depuis des jours. Razmo, déprimé, tente d’attirer l’attention de Rapido mais ce dernier reste indifférent à la crise existentielle de son pote.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Svetlana se voit offrir Bibiche, un ravissant cochon d’Inde, en récompense de ses bons et loyaux services. Rapido et Razmo, outrés par le sort que l’on réserve à leur lointain cousin rongeur, font des pieds et des mains pour lui rendre sa liberté.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Razmo travaille sur un nouveau prototype de rat-board. Persuadé qu’elle lui est destinée, Rapido lance un défi à qui veut l'entendre. Il faudra peu de temps à un challenger pour pointer son nez : Looping.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: A cause des plaisanteries idiotes de Rapido, le lutin du Père Noël refuse de livrer le cadeau de Razmo.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Razmo a un accident spectaculaire avec sa rat-board et se rend compte que cet engin peut être dangereux.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.sub-title: Un ami qui vous veut du bien
programme.desc: Fred, un pingouin soi-disant "ami des stars", s’incruste sur le cargo.

programme.title: Ratz
programme.desc: Benny fait rentrer une poule à bord pour la cuisiner. Razmo ne peut rester insensible au sort de la pauvre bête et la délivre tant bien que mal.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Les Prisonniers du Placard
programme.desc: M.O.M. envoie Martin, Diana et Java enquêter dans une université où une populaire joueuse de foot a mystérieusement disparue.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Le Réveil du Sorcier
programme.desc: Martin est un adolescent de 16 ans presque normal. En effet, quand il ne va pas au lycée il est agent spécial pour « Le Centre », une organisation secrète chargée de traquer les monstres et les phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: L'Attaque de la Plante Carnivore
programme.desc: Martin, Diana et Java sont envoyés dans une ville voisine pour examiner les disparitions de plusieurs adolescents.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: La Malédiction du Pirate
programme.desc: Pendant que Martin et l'équipe sont en visite scolaire au Musée de la Marine, Martin s'éclipse du groupe (avec Java à sa suite). Il a hâte d'examiner les objets venant d'un vaisseau légendaire qui fût autrefois commandé par un pirate fantôme en maraude.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Le Retour du Génie
programme.desc: Lorsque Diana, qui se sent seule parce qu'elle n'a pas eu de rendez-vous avec un garçon depuis longtemps, commence à recevoir des messages d'un admirateur secret, elle est excitée que quelqu'un l'ait en fait remarqué.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: Voyage au Pays de l'Epouvante
programme.desc: Martin est un adolescent de 16 ans presque normal. En effet, quand il ne va pas au lycée il est agent spécial pour « Le Centre », une organisation secrète chargée de traquer les monstres et les phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Martin Mystère: La Fureur du Farfadet
programme.desc: Lorsque Martin reçoit son premier appel sur sa nouvelle installation, "la hotline paranormale", il est totalement gonflé à bloc. Et ce, jusqu'à ce qu'il réalise que la personne ayant besoin d'aide est Marvin!

programme.title: Les Zinzins de l'Espace
programme.desc: C’est l’été. Gorgious, couvert de crème solaire à la fraise, prend un bain de soleil lorsqu’il est sauvagement piqué par une abeille gourmande !

programme.desc: A seriously twisted love triangle turned deadly when an innocent young man named Brian paid with his life. Was it a jealous lover or an online web of lies beyond anyone's imagination?

programme.title: I Met My Murderer Online
programme.desc: Carla was a beautiful, budding travel influencer who vanished while on vacation in paradise...and she was never heard from again.

programme.title: I Met My Murderer Online
programme.desc: Cody worked at a local prison in Arizona. He had a good relationship with his girlfriend until a woman on Facebook named Paige offered to meet Cody deep in the desert alone.

programme.title: I Met My Murderer Online
programme.desc: A young woman studying at the University of Utah was secretly seeking "Sugar Daddies" on a dating app. She didn't find what she was seeking, instead she found a psychopath.

programme.title: I Met My Murderer Online
programme.desc: While Tiara's husband is away working for the US Navy she meets up with a man she connected with on Craigslist Personal Ads only to be found dead four days later.

programme.title: I Met My Murderer Online
programme.desc: Tim was down on his luck and by a stroke of luck he found a job with room and board online. Maybe his luck was turning? This wouldn't be the case as he was about to meet "The Craigslist Killer".

programme.sub-title: Transporte de Pets em aviões e Teste de motores
programme.desc: Como os pets são transportados na cabine dos aviões? O Aero mostra todos os detalhes. O episódio também revela como são feitos os testes de motores dos aviões em manutenção.

programme.title: Aero, Por Trás da Aviação

programme.title: Pimp My Ride

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: O Cadillac de Nile, de Los Angeles, realmente não está em sintonia com sua imagem. Ao investir apenas 700 dólares em seu carro, Nile conseguiu o que pagou: um veículo em muito mau estado.

programme.title: Lowrider Brasil

programme.title: Pimp My Ride

programme.title: Pimp My Ride

programme.title: Lowrider Brasil

programme.title: Estradas Mortais: Pronto para Rolar

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.sub-title: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Overlord
programme.desc: After a careful campaign of disinformation that throws the German defenders off-guard, the Western Allies finally land on Normandy.France is liberated.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV
programme.desc: År 1945 fördes världen in i atomåldern. Med sin roll som bombens fader befäst blev Oppenheimer alltmer oroad över den potentiella fara som vetenskapliga uppfinningar kunde utgöra för mänskligheten.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Could the mighty M2 be the greatest machine gun in history? Nicknamed “Ma Deuce”, this American machine gun has dominated battlefields for over 80 years. Host Wil Willis tests it and recreates Audie Murphy’s famous Medal of Honor moment.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS stands for terror and the murder of millions. Documentary about the history of a symbol that represents murder.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Inspirado por la Barra de Rata de un negocio, Danny envía a los muchachos a buscar piezas para un Barra de Rata para Count's Kustoms. En la búsqueda, Danny se distrae con la belleza de un Bel Air y se encuentra del otro lado de la mesa de negociaciones.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: La realeza de la industria musical Del Bryant tiene un Blazer y quiere homenajear a sus raíces de Tennessee mientras Mike y Ryan miran un Oldmobile muy raro de 1963 que creen que el Count debe tener.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Kevin y el equipo se reúnen para hacerle algo especial a Danny. Mientras tanto, Danny se encuentra con un viejo amigo y su Corvette a gas de 1959, pero es muy atractivo cuando lo posee el rey mismo que pone de rodillas a Danny.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Como en los dibujos animados, el Plymouth Road Runner siempre ha evitado a Danny. Cuando él por fin encuentra uno y lo compra, se convierte en una pesadilla para Kevin. Cuando Kevin intenta cancelar el proyecto, Danny propone uno rápido.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny debe cederle su preciado Monte Carlo de 1972 a uno de sus mayores clientes y cuenta con su equipo para terminar el trabajo en una semana. Mientras tanto, Ryan y Mike dan el paseo de sus vidas en un Fastback Mustang de 1965.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny está inspirado para retomar un viejo proyecto, un Ford Bronco de 1967 en el que ha invertido mucho tiempo y dinero, pero para ganar dinero, el negocio tendrá que modificarlo rápidamente. Mientras tanto, un cliente trae una Harley de 1950.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny tiene un cliente listo para comprar el Ford de 1967 que está restaurando, pero el error de Ryan ha retrasado el proyecto. Mike y Roli ajustan cuentas en un campo de tiro mientras Shannon mantiene la paz. Danny mira un camión de bomberos de 1980.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Cuando se le pide a Danny que haga una moto conmemorativa que honre a la leyenda musical, debe eliminar todos los obstáculos, y espera que su equipo termine en 30 días. Mike quiere impresionar a Danny y mira un Dodge de 1940 que está a la venta.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Negro, blanco y bólido en todas partes
programme.desc: Danny y los chicos se encuentran con un cliente que quiere un trabajo de pintura para que concuerde con su auto trucado Anglia. Mientras tanto, Shannon y Ryan hacen una Harley Davidson de turismo para un cliente que usa una moto de policía readaptada.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny tiene un cliente que quiere restaurar una camioneta Ford de 1942 que vio algo de acción en la Segunda Guerra Mundial, pero cuando Danny acepta el proyecto, se entera de que necesitará más amor de lo que creía.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: El legendario rockero George Lynch de la banda metálica Dokken va de visita con su hermoso Buick Riviera de 1965.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: El “Encantador de Motores” Doc tiene un hermoso Firebird de 1967 en el que ha estado trabajando. Aunque es un maestro de la mecánica debajo del capó, no es muy habilidoso con la pintura, así que llama a Ryan para hacer que se vea lo mejor posible.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Nunca olvidas tu primer Z28 Parte 1
programme.desc: Este episodio de dos partes comienza con un cliente que le pide a Danny que busque y construya un Camaro Z28 de 1979 para conmemorar su primer auto. Luego de encontrar uno en línea, se enteran de que el auto no está en las condiciones que creían.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Nunca olvidas tu primer Z28 Parte 2
programme.desc: La batalla de Danny con la pesadilla Z28 sigue cuando lo somete a una infinita elaboración para hacerlo recobrar vida. Mientras lo revive, Danny hace una pausa para visitar la colección de autos de Steve Barton y ver si lo puede convencer de vender.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: El sueño de Danny, la pesadilla de Kevin
programme.desc: Danny quiere un Plymouth Roadrunner desde que una pareja de locos por los autos lo detuvo hace unos años y le compró su Sebring en el momento.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: Las motos de turismo no eligen
programme.desc: Un cliente quiere adornar su Harley Davidson Road Glide de 2004, pero ni Shannon ni Ryan saben si pueden hacer todo lo que quiere.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny encontró y compró un reemplazo para su amado buggy “Sparkles”. Mientras, los muchachos lo convierten en la mejor fantasía playera de los años 70.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Retan a Ryan a pintar una Harley Trike según el espíritu de “La noche estrellada” de Van Gogh, y Kevin encuentra un auto que podría ser uno de los más valiosos que haya visto… si es que es original.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny quiere que Ryan arregle una llama mal pintada en su amado auto de policía que lleva años en el negocio. Un cliente le pide a Shannon que restaure su Iron Head Sportster de 1979 que es más una pila de partes que una moto.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.sub-title: El corazón está en el cromo
programme.desc: Danny intenta retomar el proyecto abandonado del Caddy 1962, mientras Ryan intenta reparar el daño de un percance. Cuando Danny finalmente revela su Caddy de 1962 terminado, ¿el plan de pintura de Ryan hará que haya valido la pena el esfuerzo?

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny planea darle el toque Count's Kustoms a una clásica Harley Davidson que espera vender por mucho dinero, pero cuando la moto llega a Horny Mike, todo el proyecto está en peligro. Mientras tanto, Danny encuentra un Mercury raro.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.desc: Danny compra un Ford F100 de 1974 y no ve la hora de adornarlo y cambiarlo para ganar mucho dinero, pero cuando The Count se enamora de un camión y decide conservarlo, Kevin debe venderlo antes de que Danny se dé cuenta.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny sigue su amor por El Caminos con una belleza de 1975, pero si va a modificar el auto para obtener mucho dinero, el equipo de Count’s Kustoms deberá dejar de lado sus diferencias.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos
programme.desc: Danny y el equipo aceptan un Caddy para un cliente de alta gama, pero ¿funcionará el plan de Ryan y Danny de hacer concordar el interior con una pintura color cerveza de raíz? El amigo de Danny Jeff Blando de la banda Slaughter pasa por el negocio.

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.title: Locos Por los Autos

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Tra uomo e natura
programme.desc: Il Parco Nazionale d'Abruzzo è famoso non solo per la presenza del camoscio , del lupo, dell'orso marsicano, ma anche per la gente accogliente e le sue ridenti cittadine, luoghi di attività turistica e di un fiorente artigianato.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Il Parco nazionale della Majella
programme.desc: La Majella: montagna dai mille volti e dalle mille storie. Dalla vetta al fondovalle ricca di acque, pascoli, boschi e prodiga come una madre. Il lupo è l’animale simbolo del Parco Nazionale della Majella, cervi e caprioli popolano i pendii della montagna

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Nel regno della Sibilla
programme.desc: Il parco dei monti Sibillini. A cavallo tra Marche ed Umbria, sorge questo piccolo mondo di colori impossibili, panorami mozzafiato e uomini d’altri tempi. Padre Pietro ci guida un luogo dove natura, magia e tradizione si fondono in un’unica entità.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Maremma amara
programme.desc: Parco dei monti dell'Uccellina: 9000 ettari di Maremma toscana, dalle dune sabbiose alle scogliere, dalla fitta macchia alle leccete, alle pinete. Vi dimorano cinghiali, caprioli, daini e molte specie di uccelli, cavalli e vacche vivono allo stato brado.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Le Colline della Memoria
programme.desc: Le colline della Tolfa segnano l’inizio della Maremma. Abitate da pochissime persone, poche strade, poche case, pochi segni della presenza dell’uomo. Il lupo e il cinghiale vivono come ai tempi di Dante, testimonianze dei tempi passati.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Tavoliere, la Puglia dei Dauni
programme.desc: Tra Foggia e Barletta, nel cuore del Tavoliere, esiste un patrimonio archeologico, artistico e naturale da competere con quello di un intero paese europeo. Sul nostro cammino incontreremo resti di antiche città, specie animali, le saline e molto altro.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Il Parco delle meraviglie
programme.desc: Le cime del Brenta, complesso dolomitico ricco di nevai, pinnacoli, meta di alpinisti e sciatori, all’interno del Parco Naturale Adamello-Brenta. Il documentario percorre il territorio del Parco, dalle valli alle cime innevate scovando segrete meraviglie.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Dolomiti segrete, un parco da scoprire
programme.sub-title: Dolomiti segrete, un parco da scoprire
programme.desc: Le Dolomiti Bellunesi, poco note al grande pubblico, poco frequentate, a volte selvagge con una fauna ricchissima, una flora unica al mondo e tracce di storia millenaria, oggi tutelate da un giovane Parco Nazionale, tutto da esplorare.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: La montagna che visse due volte
programme.sub-title: La montagna che visse due volte
programme.desc: Le montagne del Gran Sasso e della Laga nel cuore dell’Appennino abruzzese sono state lungamente abitate e trasformate dall’uomo, oggi sono tornate a popolarsi di vita animale e vegetale, protetta all’interno di un grande parco nazionale.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Parco nazionale del Gargano
programme.desc: Il Parco Nazionale del Gargano: un ponte fra la terra e il mare, fra l'Italia e i Balcani, fra passato e presente, fra natura e uomo. Un tesoro di biodiversità animale e vegetale, siti archeologici, santuari, un racconto avvincente, immagini spettacolari.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Monti Sibillini, magia di un parco
programme.sub-title: Monti Sibillini, magia di un parco
programme.desc: Gli sconfinati altipiani di Castelluccio, paesaggio grandioso e, in primavera, la meraviglia delle sue fioriture. Norcia e Visso, racchiuse tra le loro mura medioevali. Regno di fate, i Sibillini sono la meta ideale per sognatori e amanti dei silenzi.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Il parco nazionale del Vesuvio
programme.desc: Il parco Nazionale del Vesuvio è nato a salvaguardia del vulcano più famoso del mondo dal degrado ambientale. Incendi boschivi, discariche, abusivismo edilizio, bracconaggio, sono ora solo un ricordo grazie a interventi di pulizia e recupero ambientale.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Il Gennargentu di Nateddu
programme.desc: In una valle sperduta del Gennargentu, nel cuore della Sardegna, incontriamo Nateddu, un vecchio pastore che vive in un ovile fatto di tronchi e che ci guiderà, tra il sardo e l’italiano, nel nostro viaggio nel più grande polmone selvatico d’Italia.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: L'Isola
programme.desc: La chiusura del carcere dell’Asinara ha portato gli ambientalisti a chiedere di farne un parco naturale. L’isola possiede un micro-ecosistema intatto che scopriremo tra macchia mediterranea, specie di uccelli, immagini sottomarine e magnifici scenari.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Circeo, la montagna sul mare
programme.desc: Il Parco nazionale del Circeo è la prima area protetta istituita sulle coste italiane. Fauna, flora, paesaggi, monumenti dell'uomo ne fanno una meta d'eccezione. Il nostro viaggio inizia dal promontorio del Circeo: un'autentica montagna sul mare.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Favola del vento e del mare
programme.sub-title: Favola del vento e del mare
programme.desc: I suoni eolici spiegati dal flautista-compositore Calogero Giallanza, attraverso un viaggio nell’isola di Salina e nella sua riserva naturale. Scopriremo un ecosistema controllato e protetto, in armonia con le tradizionali attività produttive dell’uomo.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Parco fluviale del Nera, il trionfo dell'acqua
programme.sub-title: Parco fluviale del Nera, il trionfo dell'acqua
programme.desc: Il Parco fluviale del Nera, ricco di testimonianze storiche e artistiche, luogo ideale per sport nella natura, è conosciuto anche come “il parco delle acque”. Famosa la Cascata delle Marmore, la più alta d’Europa, stupefacente sia di giorno che di notte.

programme.title: Parchi italiani: Cilento, un Paradiso della natura
programme.desc: Parco nazionale del Cilento, in provincia di Salerno, racchiude un angolo d'Italia ricco di natura Mediterranea: dalla costa all'entroterra i paesi campani si alternano a boschi e uliveti interrotti da ambienti fluviali integri dove vive ancora la lontra.

programme.title: L'opera selvaggia

programme.desc: En un operativo de control en el paso de motocicletas que ingresan a Brasil desde Paraguay, descubren un cargamento ilegal en una "moto-taxi" mientras que en Colombia un agente es atropellado al querer frenar un ingreso ilegal de alimentos.

programme.desc: Una madre y su hijo intentan darse a la fuga al ser interceptados por la aduana en al cruce de Ecuador a Colombia mientras que en el puente de la Amistad en Brasil la policía detiene a un menor de edad con un cargamento de marihuana.

programme.title: Sensing Murder
programme.desc: 19-year-old Joan Wech left New Zealand for the bright lights of Sydney. But the first step on her overseas adventure would be her last. Was this a robbery gone wrong, a savage random attack or a revenge killing by a jealous ex-lover?

programme.title: Sensing Murder: A Mother's Worst Nightmare
programme.desc: Otautau toddler Amber-Lee, aged two and a half, vanished from Kingston at the southern tip of Lake Wakatipu on October 17, 1992.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Last Orders
programme.desc: In 1993, devoted father Kevin O'Loughlin came face to face with the dark side of sunny Nelson when he was brutally stabbed to death after a night out on the town.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Without Warning
programme.desc: This week’s episode of Sensing Murder promises greater co-operation between psychics and police, attempting to uncover the truth about the death of 18-year-old apprentice plumber Regan O’Donoghue, who was killed in a hit and run in 2007.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Vanishing Point
programme.desc: In 2003, 32-year-old mother of three Sara Neithe vanished from the Hauraki Plains. Neither Sara nor her car have been seen since. Police suspect that Sara has been murdered but without a crime scene, they have been unable to advance the case.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: The Lie of the Land
programme.desc: Sue Nicholson and Deb Webber investigate one of the most complex and intriguing cases ever featured - did Waikato man Jason Dark commit suicide or was he murdered, as his family believes?

programme.title: Sensing Murder: When The Trail Goes Cold
programme.desc: This episodes involves the disappearance of 62-year-old Kaye Stewart, a woman who went missing while on a short walk on June 13th, 2005.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Looking for Justice
programme.desc: This week, for the first time ever, the prime suspect in a murder enquiry has turned to Sensing Murder for help.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Lost for Words
programme.desc: Spirited teenager Jayne Furlong dreamed of becoming a child psychologist - instead, she ended up a prostitute. In 1993, 17 year old Jayne vanished from her patch on Auckland's Karangahape Road.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Psychics Revealed - Special
programme.desc: Behind the scenes with the psychics on the show.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: Described as a brutal execution, 46-year-old grandmother Chattrice Maihi-Carroll was found naked, stabbed to death in her New Zealand home in 2008. There were multiple suspects and everything seemed resolved following the arrest of a neighbour.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: The Patient Killer
programme.desc: In 1976, thirteen-year-old schoolgirl Tracey Ann Patient was plucked off Auckland's Great North Road. The following morning, her body was found dumped 16 km away in the Waitakere Ranges, having been strangled with a pantyhose tourniquet.

programme.title: Sensing Murder: Little Boy Lost
programme.desc: In 1957, nine-year-old Peter Boland was on holiday having the time of his life on a remote farm in New Zealand when he simply vanished without a trace. Peter’s older brother Gavin Boland, a self-confessed sceptic, turns to Sensing Murder’s psychics.

programme.title: Il s'appelait Mandela: Résistance
programme.desc: Le mariage de Mandela avec sa deuxième épouse Winnie est très affecté par son procès. En dépit de cette crise, son rôle au sein de l'ANC se développe...

programme.title: Il s'appelait Mandela: Entrée dans la lutte armée
programme.desc: Nelson vit dans la clandestinité du gouvernement sud-africain. En créant une aile militaire de l'ANC, il quitte le pays pour s'entraîner en tant que combattant de la liberté...

programme.title: Il s'appelait Mandela: Prison à vie
programme.desc: Emprisonné à Robben Island, Nelson résiste. Cependant, avec Tambo et le reste de la direction de l’ANC en exil, le gouvernement se retourne contre Winnie…

programme.title: La Famille Katz: Tout sur ma mère
programme.desc: Théa garde le bébé mais découvre qu’Alex n’en veut pas. Osie est de plus en plus incontrôlable, et Lenny doit trouver un moyen de le garder à l'oeil. Lisette de son côté se sent menacée par le retour de Lenny chez Protectil et essaie d’embobiner Bruno.

programme.title: La Famille Katz: Pièces rapportées
programme.desc: Ce sont les soixante ans de mariage d’Osie et Milly et le vieux patriarche voit les choses en grand. Lisette prête à tout pour vendre Protectil menace Lenny de saboter le mariage de ses grand-parents s’il ne se plie pas à sa volonté.

programme.title: South Park: Woodland Critter Christmas
programme.desc: Woodland Critter Christmas: Stan finds talking animals building a Christmas tree in the woods. They enlist him to protect them from an evil mountain lion but things aren't what they seem. (S8, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Garrison's Fancy New Vagina
programme.desc: Mr Garrison's Fancy New Vagina: Mr Garrison has a sex change, Kyle has an unusual operation to make him tall and athletic enough to play basketball and Kyle's dad has "dolphinoplasty"!?! (S9, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Die Hippie, Die
programme.desc: Die Hippie, Die: Cartman runs a 'pest control' service to rid the town of hippies and is soon arrested, but when a plague of hippies invades South Park the town turn to him and his methods. (S9, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Wing
programme.desc: Wing: The boys become talent agents to make an easy buck. They take on a Chinese lady named Wing and are soon confronted by the Chinese mafia, looking for a slice of the action. Fight! (S9, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Best Friends Forever
programme.desc: Best Friends Forever: Kenny is in a coma. Cartman wants life-support turned off so he can get his PSP. But Kenny's spirit is leading the armies of heaven against the demons of hell! (S9, E04)

programme.title: South Park: The Losing Edge
programme.desc: The Losing Edge: The boys are bored of playing baseball, and concoct a plan to lose the big play-off game. Randy trains hard to become the biggest drunken jackass at each match. (S9, E05)

programme.title: South Park: The Death of Eric Cartman
programme.desc: The Death of Eric Cartman: Everyone decides to ignore Cartman! He is convinced he is dead and must find peace by making amends for his past sins. Will Butters' 'psychic ability' help him? (S9, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Erection Day
programme.desc: Erection Day: Jimmy's noticed that one of his body parts has a mind of his own, so he tries to control his raging hormones in time to perform his comedy routine at the School Talent Show. (S9, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: Marjorine
programme.desc: Marjorine: Cartman is convinced that the girls have a device which can see into the future. The boys come up with a plan to take it. Unfortunately for Butters he's a major part of the plan. (S9, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Follow That Egg
programme.desc: Follow That Egg: In a bid to prevent Mr. Slave from marrying Big Gay Al, Mrs. Garrison forces the children to help him in an experiment to prove that gay marriages are unstable. (S9. E10)

programme.title: South Park: Ginger Kids
programme.desc: Ginger Kids: After giving a hate speech against 'the gingers', Cartman awakens the next day with a case of 'Gingervitus' and soon rallies against the persecution of his fellow red heads. (S9, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Free Willzyx
programme.desc: Free Willzyx: The boys are tricked into believing the killer whale at Sea Park is from the moon. How will Timmy's wheelchair, the Russian government and their skateboards help to free him? (S9, E13)

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Bloody Mary: Randy is arrested for drunk driving and must attend AA, where he is told he is powerless to control himself. Maybe the bleeding Virgin Mary statue can perform a miracle or two? (S9, E14)

programme.title: South Park: The Return of Chef
programme.desc: The Return of Chef: The boys notice that Chef is acting weird after returning from the 'The Super Adventure Club'. Why is he trying to seduce them? Can a trip to a strip joint help? (S10, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Smug Alert!
programme.desc: Smug Alert: Kyle's father buys a new hybrid car but it's not long before his smug levels reach ridiculous levels - must be time to move to San Fran! How will Cartman deal with no Kyle? (S10, E02)

programme.title: South Park: A Million Little Fibers
programme.desc: A Million Little Fibers: Towlie writes his memoirs and it's not long before he's invited onto The Oprah Winfrey Show. (S10, E05)

programme.title: South Park: ManBearPig
programme.desc: ManBearPig: Ex U.S. Vice President Al Gore visits South Park Elementary and warns the pupils about ManBearPig, a monster which is "half man, half bear and half pig" - you can't be "cereal"! (S10, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Random Targets
programme.desc: Most victims of multiple murderers are meticulously chosen because of a mutual connection with the killer or because they match an intricate set of criteria that fits the killer's MO.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Burning Evidence
programme.desc: Identifying Burned Remains: It's difficult to have a murder investigation without a body, and burning up the victim is a time-honored method of destroying physical evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Unlikely Sources
programme.desc: Some of the best clues come from the least likely places. Baffling crimes have been solved and criminals betrayed through evidence provided by insects, beer bottles, and other seemingly meaningless objects.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory. The hotel owner looks for a way out from marrying the man to whom her dying father promised her.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: An assassination plot unfolds as four gunmen disguised as cavalrymen enter North Fork. Their target: Sen. Jim Borden. Their weapon: a Gatling gun.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Sharpshooter Marty Blair tries to persuade Lucas to buy Mark a rifle. After Lucas shoots a man during a robbery at the hotel, Mark and Lucas disagree with his character.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Fast-draw artist Wade Randall is in town, bragging of his gun battles with notorious bad men until one of them shows up to challenge his story.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Lucas refuses to sell his land, Mr. Prescott will stop at nothing to change his mind. He hires men to try to persuade Lucas, but he refuses.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas's self-confidence begins to slip away when he misses an easy shot that could have cost Mark his life.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The first railroad train is coming to the new North Fork station. Onboard is a Japanese nobleman and his servant, visiting the West to learn about the United States.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: At Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch. Lucas' faith in his son's honesty is shaken when he hears rumors of Mark being mixed up with the thieves.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm. Lucas' life is endangered when a snake crawls into his bed.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark is injured in an accident, leaving his legs paralyzed. At the doctor's suggestion, Lucas and Mark set out on a trek to Mission Springs.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mario Arsatti claims to be an acquaintance of a good friend from Lucas' past. But it's pleasure before business. Mario has been hired to kill Lucas.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas, who blames his wife's death on his father-in-law, refuses to help the old man elude a gang of gunmen.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The lazy Jackman brother's mortgage has been foreclosed. Unfit for farming, they head to a nearby town. The family patriarch becomes marshal and deputizes his sons.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely. Old Tony invites them to lunch and lets them look for arrowheads on a remote part of his land.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him and breaks his leg doing so.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: The notorious Shelton rides into the town of North Fork to take revenge on an elderly Marshal who is now crippled and working for Lucas McCain.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: Johnny Gibbs, Lucas McCain's brother-in-law, visits the McCain ranch. Gibbs, a rodeo rider wanted by the law, begins stirring up trouble.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A vengeful judge who believes Lucas was responsible for his son's death, kidnaps Mark McCain to revenge himself on Lucas.

programme.title: The Rifleman
programme.desc: A handsome Italian count arrives in North Fork. The town bully ridicules his manner of speech and dress and provokes the Count to challenge him to a duel.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick encuentra una granja en la que buscar ayuda para salvar la vida de su hijo, quien recibió el impacto accidental de una bala. Después, Shane entra en una escuela llena de zombis para llevarse material sanitario junto al tipo que disparó a Carl.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane y Otis están atrapados por los zombis en la escuela adonde acudieron por el material sanitario necesario para operar a Carl. En la granja, surgen las primeras tensiones y Daryl y Andrea vuelven a salir en busca de Sophie.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Shane regresa a la granja con las medicinas, pero el sacrificio que ha tenido que cometer no es bien visto por el resto del grupo. En la granja, el grupo intenta sacar a un zombi del pozo de agua fresca antes de que la infecte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Mientras busca a Sophia, Daryl sufre un accidente que lo deja perdido y herido en el bosque. La tensión entre el grupo y los propietarios de la granja aumenta, así como la inestabilidad del propio grupo, debido a que Shane desafía a Rick.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Tras descubrir que la familia mantiene encerrada a sus familiares convertidos en zombis en el granero, Dale confronta a Hershel. Lori, por su parte, confiesa a Rick que está embarazada y los problemas entre los integrantes del grupo se intensifican.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Glenn le revela a todo el grupo el secreto del granero, pero no están de acuerdo sobre cómo actuar: Rick ordena respetar la autoridad de Hershel, aunque Shane quiere acabar con los zombis. Por otra parte, descubren por fin qué le ha pasado a Sophia.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Hershel no soporta lo ocurrido y recae en su alcoholismo, pero Rick y Glenn lo siguen hasta la ciudad para evitar que muera. Entretanto, Beth, incapaz de aceptar todo lo que le está sucediendo a su familia, entra en estado catatónico.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Lori sale en busca de Rick, pero lo único que encuentra es un peligro mortal y Shane va tras ella. Entretanto, Rick, Hershel y Glenn mantienen un tiroteo con los desconocidos con quienes cruzaron sus caminos en el bar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: La tensión entre Rick y Shane aumenta y la decisión sobre el destino de Randall es el detonante: Shane quiere matarlo, Rick prefiere dejarlo vivo. Mientras, Beth pretende suicidarse y Andrea, quien debe vigilarla, no cumple con su cometido.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo descubre que Randall es un violador y asesino y acuerdan ejecutarlo, pero Dale se opone porque eso los convertiría también en criminales. Mientras tanto, Carl comete un error que acarreará consecuencias imprevistas.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Las diferencias entre Rick y Shane por el liderato del grupo y la gestión de la granja se intensifican cuando Shane decide por su cuenta el destino de Randall. La tensión termina estallando y los dos amigos se enfrentan a muerte.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.sub-title: Junto al fuego que se extingue
programme.desc: Una horda de zombis invade la granja y el grupo intenta escapar vivo entre el caos, pero no todos lo lograrán. Además, Rick se harta de las quejas del grupo y les da un ultimátum: si quieren que sea el líder, acatarán sus órdenes.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo encuentra refugio en las instalaciones de una prisión federal abandonada tras meses en la carretera. Rick considera que se trata de un lugar seguro para que Lori pase los últimos meses de embarazo, pero quizá se haya equivocado.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Rick accede a dejar salir de sus celdas a los prisioneros si les ayudan a matar a los zombis que quedan en la prisión. Entretanto, la salud de Hershel empeora por momentos.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Andrea y Michonne descubren una comunidad de sobrevivientes liderada por un hombre llamado el Gobernador. Allá les ofrecen medicinas, comida, agua caliente y ropa limpia, pero Michonne desconfía del Gobernador y sus verdaderas intenciones.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: En Woodbury, Michonne desconfía del Gobernador y planea irse sin Andrea. En la prisión, un sabotaje provoca que una horda de zombis penetre en la cárcel y, mientras Rick y sus compañeros los combaten, Lori entra en trabajo de parto.
